decisions.reason: Pushing HubSpot lists to MeetAlfred does not change the separate Apollo-to-HubSpot contact transfer.
The source establishes general HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred list transfer but does not change or resume the deferred silent-lead follow-up workflow.
The connection request does not change the requirement to configure MeetAlfred or its selected subscription plan.
Connecting an email account to MeetAlfred and HubSpot does not necessarily resume or modify the separate deferred automated email campaign.
The source does not change the LinkedIn campaign's channel, automation mode, or platform.
Adding email and list connections does not alter the obligation to preserve existing MeetAlfred integrations and campaigns.
The source does not mention or change Zapier configuration, subscription, or add-on requirements.
The source contains no testing instruction and does not change restrictions on using production leads or identities.
The ability to push lists to MeetAlfred does not change HubSpot's internal lead-management properties, stages, categorization, or list support.
Connecting email systems does not explicitly change the requirement for email and LinkedIn chat histories to be visible in HubSpot.
The source's email-connection clause is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event, so no additional or edited MODIFY is required.
The HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred list-transfer decision does not resolve or change the separate LinkedIn-to-HubSpot integration and subscription conflict.
